Name: Rishi
Question: Do most flight attendants have bachelor's degrees?
Answer: I have worked with FA who were ex-military, licenced doctors, qualified pilots, nurses, engineers from all fields, etc… I myself hold a bachelor's degree in Hotel administration and Hospitality and was working as a chef earlier. I wouldn't comment on the majority as I have worked only with 1 airline in the Gulf but I have come across a wide variety of qualified professionals who either got bored, found this job (of being a FA) more lucrative because of its remuneration and added perks or some other reason.. This job per say doesn't require any such qualification expect having been passed 12th grade. However it's always gives me a sense of relief of having been completed my graduation, cause Aviation industry is one of the first industries to take a direct hit incase of recession and economic breakdown, so at least you've got something to fall back on even in the worst case scenario.
